content.text:
**Finding: Compliant** — no MFN obligation burdening us.

- No MFN, "most favoured nation", "no less favourable terms", or third-party price-matching language appears anywhere in the Agreement.
- Section 1 (p0001) runs in our favour: it disclaims exclusivity and confirms the Agreement "will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties."
- This sits at the preferred position (no MFN burden on Customer), so no redline was proposed.
